pages.text: $(l)Where affixes come from$()$(br)A hostile mob gets affixes when it spawns, by the highest experience level of the players nearby, written $(l)L$().$(br2)Each affix gives it +3 attack, +5 health, +2 armor, and another 10% of each (they add up).

$(l)Drops$()$(li)Alchemical essence: 50% (+10% per Looting level); bosses always.$(li)Affix materials: if the killer has 20 luck and level 20, 5% (+1.5% per Looting level), one of its affixes at random, at most one; a boss always drops one.$(li)Boss materials: the killer needs 100 luck.$(br2)Split copies and affixes lent by Amplify drop none.

$(l)Transmuting materials$()$(br)On a transmutation altar, an ordinary affix material (main) with a transmutation source, a copper ingot, a gold ingot and an amethyst shard turns into another random ordinary affix material. Nothing repeats within a round: every other material comes out once before a new round begins.$(br2)$(l)Affix accessories$()$(br)Each ordinary affix has an accessory that wards it off; see the Affix Accessories chapter.

pages.title: Full Moon and Richer Spoils
pages.text: $(l)The moon's tide$(): Overworld monsters wax and wane with the moon. Full moon strongest (health +40%, attack +25%, one more affix when rolled); gibbous +20%/+12%; quarters as they are; crescents -10%/-5%; new moon -15%/-10%. On a full moon's night everyone in the Overworld gains $(l)Inspiration$().$(br2)$(l)More affixes, richer spoils$(): each affix (a boss affix counts 3) gives a player's kill +10% drops, a 25% chance of another loot roll and +15% experience.
